hypothesis: Predict current identity appearance from strictly earlier accepted latent observations, with stopped current targets and same-frame different-fish contrast to avoid average-feature collapse.
representation: Frozen main original-crop post-neck encoders, dimension512, fixed epoch12; this first predictive trial is separate from prospective crop repair.
history_order: Accepted observations sorted strictly before current query, right padded, maximum8; no current candidate enters history before scoring
prediction: Normalized residual from last observation; output projection starts at zero. Empty history explicitly unavailable, zero output, geometry fallback.
time_features: Known current query minus each past timestamp and consecutive accepted-observation gaps, scaled by37 and capped at2; no future motion or observations
loss: Cosine latent prediction plus same-frame different-identity candidate CE, temperature0.1. Target/current candidate tensors stopped; encoders receive no gradient.
ordinary_temporal_control: Same GRU/Transformer and training budget, candidate association CE only, no cosine forecasting objective
memory_controls: FIFO normalized mean from identical8 observations
clean_online_controls: Teacher-forced physically matched histories versus actual accepted RGB-tracker histories with original past identity anchor; contamination labels are training diagnostics, never inference inputs
checkpoint_selection: Fixed last epoch8, no historical test tuning
safe_writes: Independent later ablation on same fixed predictor weights; confidence and assignment-margin refusal/damping use observable current quantities only, never GT. Geometry updates remain separate.
candidate_policy: Same geometry-gated current proposal pool for all predictive and matched history controls. A separate bounded-EMA baseline and constant-vector control must measure any effect of widening the original RGB distance gate; do not credit a candidate-rule change to forecasting.
scope: Prospective Phase III specification and initial module, not a trained PLIM result. Final three-seed/full-video/native strongest baseline comparisons and actual end-to-end costs remain required. SN-015 holds out temporal query fitting, not the already-trained main fish encoder.
